scope.buyer_profile: International residential buyer, property budget from EUR 1,000,000
scope.approach: Exceptional-value amenities only; Benidorm plus its practical premium catchment on Costa Blanca.

places.name: Elian's British School of La Nucía

photo.usage_note: Use the official source page to obtain/licence the image; avoid hotlinking transient CDN URLs.

places.summary: One of the strongest education arguments close to Benidorm: British curriculum from early years through secondary, plus the IB Diploma. Particularly relevant to internationally mobile families and families combining academics with high-level sport.

rating.note: School-review sample is relatively small; treat as sentiment, not academic-quality ranking.

places.name: Lady Elizabeth School

photo.selection: Official campus hero image showing the Cumbre del Sol setting
photo.usage_note: Confirm image rights before commercial reuse.

places.summary: A serious British-school option for buyers willing to use the wider Costa Blanca catchment: ages 2–18, British pathway, highly international student body and boarding from age 13. It adds a boarding-school-style option that Benidorm itself does not offer at this level.

rating.note: Aggregator sentiment only; not an academic league-table score.

places.name: Lope de Vega International School

photo.selection: Official campus image showing academic and sports facilities
photo.usage_note: Confirm image rights before commercial reuse.

places.summary: The most convenient substantial international-school proposition inside Benidorm itself: a large campus around 1.5 km from the sea, boarding/residential capability and extensive sports infrastructure. Convenience is the core buyer value here.

rating.aggregator: Google Business Profile via local review aggregator

places.name: Quique Dacosta Restaurante

photo.usage_note: Confirm image rights before commercial reuse.

places.summary: The region's destination-dining anchor: three Michelin stars in the 2026 Guide and a globally recognised chef-led experience in Dénia. For a luxury buyer, this materially upgrades the perception of the northern Costa Blanca from resort coast to serious gastronomic territory.

places.name: BonAmb

photo.usage_note: Confirm image rights before commercial reuse.

places.summary: Two Michelin stars in the 2026 Guide, giving the Benidorm–Marina Alta corridor a second genuine destination restaurant rather than a single isolated flagship. This matters to buyers who value repeatable fine-dining depth.

places.name: Orobianco

photo.selection: Official terrace image with Mediterranean and Peñón de Ifach panorama
photo.usage_note: Confirm image rights before commercial reuse.

places.summary: A one-Michelin-star 2026 restaurant in Calpe whose strongest real-estate-sales value is the combination of high-end Italian cooking, rooftop/private-event potential and dramatic Peñón de Ifach/Mediterranean views.

places.name: Villaitana Golf

photo.selection: Panoramic course image showing fairways, resort and Benidorm skyline
photo.usage_note: Confirm image rights before commercial reuse.

places.summary: The clearest golf argument inside Benidorm: two distinct 18-hole Nicklaus Design courses, including the 6,576 m Levante championship-style course, plus academy and practice facilities. It converts golf from a day-trip amenity into a routine lifestyle amenity.

places.name: Marina Greenwich / Puerto Deportivo Campomanes

photo.selection: Official aerial marina image with the bay and yacht berths
photo.usage_note: Confirm image rights before commercial reuse.

places.summary: The strongest nearby yachting infrastructure for a premium homeowner: 542 berths for boats roughly 7–40 m, 24-hour staff, dry dock, yacht-management services and a waterfront commercial/restaurant area. Much more persuasive for a yacht owner than Benidorm's small city marina alone.

places.name: Club Nàutic de Benidorm

photo.selection: Harbour/club image showing the city-centre waterfront setting
photo.usage_note: Confirm image rights before commercial reuse.

places.summary: Small rather than superyacht-scale, but strategically valuable because it puts sailing, rowing, kayaking and regatta activity directly in Benidorm. The buyer value is daily convenience and access to the sea, not marina scale.

places.name: Parc Natural de la Serra Gelada

photo.selection: Cliff-and-sea landscape from the Benidorm side of Serra Gelada
photo.usage_note: Check the licence and attribution shown on the Wikimedia Commons file page.

places.summary: Benidorm's most defensible natural-luxury asset: a protected maritime-terrestrial landscape with cliffs over 300 m, hiking and marine habitat immediately beside the urban coast. It gives high-rise waterfront living a genuine nature counterweight.

places.name: Playa de Poniente

photo.selection: Wide-angle beach and sculptural promenade image
photo.usage_note: Confirm image rights before commercial reuse.

places.summary: The strongest premium-residential beach story in Benidorm: about 3.1 km of sand, a calmer positioning than Levante and a distinctive promenade. It is especially relevant for luxury towers and apartments where walk-out beach access is the central purchase emotion.

places.name: SHA Wellness Clinic

photo.selection: Official panoramic SHA building/pool image overlooking the Mediterranean
photo.usage_note: Confirm image rights before commercial reuse.

places.summary: A globally recognised luxury medical-wellness and longevity destination next to Benidorm's northern edge. For affluent buyers, this is one of the region's rare amenities that can credibly compete with established international wellness destinations.

places.name: ZEM Wellness Clinic Altea

photo.selection: Official architecture/interior image showing the high-end longevity-clinic environment
photo.usage_note: Confirm image rights before commercial reuse.

places.summary: A new-generation luxury longevity clinic in Altea Hills combining diagnostics, personalised programmes, regenerative/integrative medicine, spa and fitness. Together with SHA, it creates an unusually dense high-end wellness cluster for this part of Spain.

rating.note: Very small review sample; do not compare the score directly with mature venues.

places.name: IMED Levante Hospital

photo.selection: Official exterior/facilities image for IMED Levante
photo.usage_note: Confirm image rights before commercial reuse.

places.summary: A practical rather than glamorous luxury-buyer asset: a major private hospital in Benidorm with 24-hour emergency, surgery, diagnostics and strong experience with international patients. It materially reduces the 'what happens if something goes wrong?' objection for foreign families.

rating.note: Consumer-review score reflects service experience and should not be treated as a clinical-quality metric.

places.name: Alicante-Elche Miguel Hernández Airport — General Aviation / T2

photo.usage_note: Confirm image rights before commercial reuse.

places.summary: The key international-access argument for Benidorm: a major Costa Blanca airport with a dedicated general-aviation terminal and executive handling capability. For a second-home buyer, frequent direct air access and private-aviation support are more decision-relevant than prestige retail inside the city.

places.name: Asia Gardens Hotel & Thai Spa

photo.usage_note: Confirm image rights before commercial reuse.

places.summary: A five-star resort environment immediately outside Benidorm with extensive Asian gardens, nine pools, multiple restaurants, Thai spa, tennis/padel and concierge-style hospitality. It is useful in sales because it demonstrates that resort-grade luxury already exists locally, rather than only in Marbella or Mallorca.
